model: multi-collateral (branch per collateral, Liquity-V2 / Enosys style)
note: One shared VUSD; one branch (PriceOracle + VaultManager [+ VulcraZap on FXRP]) per collateral, each granted VUSD MINTER_ROLE. External runtime ABI of VaultManager is identical across branches — multi-collateral = multiple instances, not new signatures. Contract addresses below are filled by the coordinator after running `script/DeployVulcra.s.sol` (broadcast gated behind PRIVATE_KEY). Collateral tokens + registry are resolved on-chain via FlareContractRegistry; token addresses shown for reference only.
deployOrder: FXRP branch: PriceOracle(XRP/USD) -> VaultManager(FXRP,6dec) -> grant VUSD.MINTER_ROLE -> VulcraZap -> grant ZAP_ROLE
wFLR branch: PriceOracle(FLR/USD) -> VaultManager(wFLR,18dec) -> grant VUSD.MINTER_ROLE (no Zap)
optional: grant GUARDIAN_EXECUTOR_ROLE(keeper) on each branch
vaultManagerInit: initialize(admin, collateralToken, collateralDecimals(uint8), oracle, vusd, feeReceiver, Params{mcrBps,minDebt18,mintFeeBps,liqBonusBps,redemptionFeeBps}, debtCeiling)

deprecated_single_collateral.note: Superseded by the multi-collateral model above; kept for reference. These live single-collateral contracts predate the collateral-agnostic VaultManager and should be treated as retired.
